package shop

import "testing"

// The site's words count: one found, two found, in pt_br, as
// TestSSRDrawsItsIconsAndYours writes it beside icons.go.
func TestCountWords(t *testing.T) {
	for count, want := range map[string]string{"1": "1 encontrado", "2": "2 encontrados", "0": "0 encontrados", "1.234": "1.234 encontrados"} {
		if got := T("count", "count", count); got != want {
			t.Errorf("T(count, %s) = %q, want %q", count, got, want)
		}
	}
	if got := T("pageTitle", "title", "1", "site", "Loja"); got != "1 · Loja" {
		t.Errorf("pageTitle: %q", got)
	}
}
